component.name: Agentry
component.summary: Desktop UI for Claude Code agents

description.p: Agentry runs Claude Code as a service: a REST API, a web UI and multi-agent orchestration around the Claude Code CLI. The desktop app bundles the API and the UI into one window.

ul.li: Every conversation, from anywhere: start a run, stream the tokens, answer follow-up turns and pick up any session the CLI has ever written on the machine
Orchestration: a graph of tasks, each with its own Claude worker, run in parallel with dependency context and a synthesis step, drafted for you by an auto-planner
Multi-account rotation: usage per window and proactive switching before an account runs out of quota
The whole configuration surface: settings, instructions, MCP servers, agents, skills, commands, output styles, memory and plugins, per user and per project

description.p: Agentry drives Claude only through the CLI, so the Claude Code CLI must be installed and signed in.

screenshot.caption: The accounts page: usage per window for each account and the auto-rotation policy
